Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional meat‑based lasagna (you can adjust or omit items to suit dietary preferences): | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • 12–15 sheets of lasagna noodles (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or whole‑tomato sauce
• 1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce (optional for extra thickness)
• 1 cup beef or vegetable broth (optional)
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• ½ tsp dried thyme
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• Salt & pepper | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (part‑mozzarella or part‑cheddar blend) | | **Parmesan Crust** | • ½–¾ cup grated Parmesan (for topping) | | **Optional Extras** | • ½ cup chopped fresh spinach or kale (folded into ricotta)
• ½ cup sliced mushrooms (sautéed with the meat)
• 1 tbsp olive oil (for sautéing)
• Fresh basil or parsley for garnish | ### Quick Prep Steps 1. **Cook the noodles** (if using regular pasta) until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment to prevent sticking. 2. **Make the meat sauce**: Sauté onion & garlic in olive oil until translucent; add ground meat, cook until browned; stir in tomatoes, broth, herbs, salt, pepper; simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Mix ricotta filling**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, pepper (and optional greens). 4. **Assemble**: Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a baking dish, layer noodles, ricotta mixture, sauce, mozzarella, repeat until all layers are used, finishing with a generous layer of mozzarella + Parmesan on top. 5. **Bake**: Cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
